searchText: I talked with the various client teams about potentially including EIP-3860 and others alongside a difficulty bomb pushback in December, and the rough consensus seems to be that people prefer to keep the December upgrade to the difficulty bomb only. I've shared my thoughts for next steps based on this on the ACD agenda issue: https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/391#issuecomment-924197948
